prompt: Rewrite this note as a clear, friendly notice for apartment residents: 'The hallway painting starts Tuesday. There will be workers. Bikes and boxes are in the way. Move them Monday night. We think the job ends Thursday, but the weather may affect drying.' Preserve the uncertainty. Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text:
**Hallway Painting Notice**

Hallway painting will begin on Tuesday. Workers will need clear access to all corridors, so please remove any bikes, boxes, or other personal belongings by Monday evening.

We expect the work to be completed by Thursday. However, drying times may be affected by weather conditions, so the schedule could change. Thank you for helping us keep the hallways clear and for your patience during this improvement.
